newsitem.title: UK: Eurobond trade ideas - Dollar switches dominate.
newsitem.headline: Eurobond trade ideas - Dollar switches dominate.

text.p: Bond analysts' latest Eurobond trade ideas featured the dollar, yen and Danish crown, with Eurodollar switches particularly popular.

Sanwa International said dollar bonds looked attractive relative to bond markets in Europe and Japan and Japanese investors were drawn to the dollar market because of the currency's appreciation against the yen.
Yamaichi said in the Euroyen market there had been increased demand from central banks for better credits, which reversed the trend of recent weeks.
This prompted a better tone for the professional side of the market and away from credits such as Italy and Spain. They said there would be further spread tightening in the near term.
**Following are latest trade ideas, compiled by Reuters** EURODOLLAR
Sanwa International recommends:
BUY Ontario 7.0 pct 01/99
SELL Ontario 7.375 pct 01/03
STRATEGY A steeper dollar bond yield curve has seen the
spread between the two Ontario bonds widen to 69 b.p. from 60 b.p. in September. It may go out further to 80 b.p. in the next weeks, still short of the 103 b.p. gap seen earlier this year.
A stronger dollar against the yen will also boost demand for shorter-dated dollar bonds.
Steepening trades in dollars benefit from the positive cost of carry between short-term money market rates and two- to three-year notes.
The spread between three-month Eurodollars and three-year U.S. Treasuries is around 61 b.p. While this has been narrowing of late, it still beats the one-year average by 29 b.p.
HSBC Markets recommends:
BUY UK 6.75 pct 07/01
SELL UK 7.25 pct 12/02
STRATEGY This credit neutral trade can be done for even
yield, effectively picking up the curve worth seven b.p. The trade also takes out 7.5 points in cash.
Paribas Capital Markets recommends:
BUY World Bank 6.375 pct 07/05
SELL World Bank 5.25 pct 09/03
STRATEGY This gives a pick-up of 38 b.p. Neither of
these deals are tax exempt but offer the same liquidity. The curve is worth around 9 b.p. and this beats the curve by 29 b.p. This is a six-month high. The average was 28 b.p. and the low was 18 b.p.
BUY GMAC 6.75 pct 09/99
SELL GMAC 6.50 pct 06/98
STRATEGY With a pick up of 40 b.p. and the curve worth
approximately 20 b.p. this switch beats the curve by 20 b.p. This is a one-month high, with the average spread 34 b.p. and the low 17 b.p. EUROYEN Yamaichi recommends:
BUY World Bank 4.75 pct 2004
SELL JGB 174 4.60 pct 2004
STRATEGY This follows the improved demand for Euroyen of
good credit. It gives a pick-up of two b.p. against a recent average give-up of around 10 b.p. DANISH CROWN
BUY Oresundkonsortiet 4.0 pct 11/02
STRATEGY This issue is trading at around five b.p. over
the Danish government 6.00 percent 2002 bond.
This issue has a 4.00 percent coupon, the first deal which meets the new minimum coupon fixing requirement in the domestic Danish market.
This makes it very attractive to Danish domestic retail investors. It is free of capital gains and encourages investors to move out of government bonds.
--Johanna Vellender, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7658
